_about: Public-domain Bishop John Milner (1752-1826, Vicar Apostolic of the Midland District) for the Word Hoard: Letters to a Prebendary (1800) and the History of Winchester (2 vols, second edition, 1809), from Internet Archive scans. The End of Religious Controversy (3 parts, 1818) is pending: its title page gives only the initials J. M. Written in English. Not Joseph Milner the church historian, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
